keys.swarm.aura_bastion_dome_desc: A dome drops where you stand and stays there: monsters inside it crawl, and you take less damage inside.
keys.swarm.aura_bastion_dome_up: A bigger, stronger dome that lasts longer.
keys.swarm.aura_bastion_dome_ten: Aegis: a golden sphere that travels with you.
keys.swarm.aura_avalanche_fall_desc: Rocks fall from above onto the thickest crowd on screen.
keys.swarm.aura_avalanche_fall_ten: Mountain Fall: one colossal rock crushes the biggest crowd.
